name: Alexandra
story: Alexandra Tamsanqa is a Silver Knight of the Temple Army at Jurah Temple in Dagsion, nicknamed the Silver Maiden. She comes from a privileged background, her parents are dead, and she has an unnamed uncle. She can be recruited from around 29/5 and is easiest to get on Theodora's route (Renown 6). She has an A-rank support with Cai.

personalSkill.name: Silver Maiden
personalSkill.effect: Hit/Avo+5 for each adjacent ally. Lv20: Soar (AS+3 on inaccessible terrain); Lv35: Soar+ (AS+5).

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics: A tier. KeenGamer: B tier (55% Spd, 50% Lck flier). Reddit: mediocre offense; serviceable flier with decent Def/Res; low HP (single-report pattern).

why: Lowest Support requirement of any route: 1 here vs Cai 2, Dietrich 3, Leda 3.
Supports Theodora and Sirocco, both in this army.
recruit.tip: Gift her the first Sunday of Ch 8, seat her with Theodora and Sirocco, then recruit her that week: she deploys on the Ch 8 map.

build.role: Lead flier, sword striker and Res dodge tank
path: Wing Soldier (Ch 9 to end of Part II)
build.notes: Recruit Ch 8 week 1 at about Lv 15 in a Beginner class; Wing Soldier on Bucephalus at Lv 20 (Ch 9) grows Spd 80, Res 50. She stays mounted through Part II (no Guardian stint) and takes Celestial Trooper at Lv 45 for Lightning Reflexes.

guide.role: Lead flier, sword striker and Res dodge tank
guide.summary: The army's lead flier and its carry: a fast sword striker who also tanks mages. She joins in Ch 8 at about Lv 15, flies from Ch 9 on Bucephalus and ends as a Celestial Trooper whose Lightning Reflexes hits twice before the counter. Keep her beside Loretta, Lysander or Lilian (the Strike group) for Silver Maiden and out of bow range.
guide.playstyle: Player phase: fly in, double with the Da Mina Sword, or hit armor with Lightning Strike, then end beside two allies. Enemy phase: bait mages on the Res side and stay out of bow range.
keys: Recruit her Ch 8 week 1: gift, then the Theodora + Sirocco meal, then recruit
Barter the Levin Sword on join; [[item:Da Mina Sword]] at Sword C (Ch 9): Mt 15 at +1, Wt 4
Book Arena Mounted and Infantry every Ch 8 week: Spear C and Sword C by Lv 20
Take [[class:Wing Soldier]] on Bucephalus at Lv 20 (Ch 9): Spd 80, Res 50 growth
End every turn beside 2 allies: Silver Maiden Hit/Avo +10
Split kills between sword and spear: [[class:Celestial Trooper]] needs both at A
watch: Weight: Da Mina Sword 4 + Phantom Ring 3 = 7 in Parts I-II. Part III: Iron Sword +4 4 + Gale Ring 2 + Shield of Zephyrus 5 = 11; bow-free map: shield off first (AS +5 past Bld).
Bows: Effective+ (3x Mt) vs fliers. Check every bow's range before you end her turn.
Join level: about Lv 15 in Ch 8, ~10 under the core. Feed her kills to Lv 20.
Inventory: 5 core (Da Mina Sword, Levin Sword, Da Mina Spear, Phantom Ring, Concoction); slot 6 swaps.
Lightning Reflexes: AS +10 over the foe when she attacks first. Gale Ring (Spd +3), Soar+ (AS +5) and Flitting Flier (AS +2) build it.

routeNotes.note: Partners here: Theodora and Sirocco. Meal seat: Theodora + Sirocco + Alexandra. On the map she ends turns with the Strike group (Loretta, Lysander, Lilian) for Silver Maiden.
On foot in Ch 8 she borrows Zarcone's [[battalion:Hunter-Drifters]]. From Wing Soldier she flies, so it goes back and her Cha feeds no gambit.
Northern Passage (Theodora only in Part I) holds her Phantom Ring (Avo +5) after the Ch 9 story section.

decisions.why: Two more maps, four more Arena weeks and earlier Support with Theodora and Sirocco. She takes Zarcone's seat on the Ch 8 map; a Ch 10 join (Lv 25) skips the Beginner stage but costs all of that.
decisions.else: Renown 6 late? Recruit the week it lands
